book.name: Macho
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Macho gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Ŋgaŋ kune ŋka wu bvuguu
Jiso ka wu jɛmɛ bo le a baŋgaŋ le, wumu nyu lɛ,

content.text: “Bvunfoŋ bvu fɛwe taŋlo ba beji bɛ nfoŋ wumu wù gɛ̀ seesɛ ŋka wu bvuguu bvu mwa ye wù jwɛŋsɛ.
Wu tuŋ booŋ be ba lɛme lɛ bo gɛɛŋ bo tɛɛŋ bamii ba wu chi be bo fɛ ŋka wu bvuguu le lɛ bo tôo. Geenɛ, booŋ bayu gɛɛŋ bamii bayu faŋ lɛ gɛ bo to gɛ.

Wu tuŋ banchɛndaa bamu wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ, ‘Bɛŋ gɛɛŋ bɛŋ jɛmɛ bamii ba nchi ntɛŋe fɛ ŋka wu bvuguu wunɛ le lɛ bo yegɛ bo yu, nle seesɛ wa mwɛɛ munjile, nsɛɛyɛ nyáŋ yì ba bvuushɛ bɛ booŋ ba banaa ba faŋ. Nle nseesɛ wa mwɛɛ munchii, lɛ bo tôo fɛ ŋka le.’
Geenɛ, bo gɛɛŋ bamii bayu chiaasɛ lo, bo ja fiboo bo gɛɛne. Muh mu la a wu mwɛne, muh mu la waaŋ we.
Kimbɛge ki bamii koo booŋ bayu bo nyiɛ bɛ bo, bo mo bo yuuyɛ bo.
Fitele bɛdɛ nfoŋ wɛɛ, wu tuŋ bamii be ba jɛŋ, bo gɛɛŋ bo lɛɛshɛ lo bamii ba yuuyi booŋ be ba lɛme baa, bo mo bo toŋ kilaantɛŋ kiboo.
No wu ge noo wu mo wu jɛmɛ booŋ be ba lɛme bamu le lɛ, ‘Nle nseesɛ wa ŋka wu bvuguu. Geenɛ bamii ba nchi mbe chi bee gɛ bamii gɛ.
Bɛŋ gɛɛŋ ntasɛ yi jé le yichii, bɛŋ tɛɛŋ bamii bachii ba bɛŋ le bɛŋ yɛŋ, lɛ bo to fɛ ŋka wu bvuguu wunɛ le.’
Banchɛndaa baa mo bo gɛɛŋ jé le yichii bo kuŋ bamii bachii ba bo gɛ̀ yɛŋ le bamii ba joŋe bɛ ba befe bo to. Yeh yi bvuguu mo yi yisɛ bɛ bamii.
Nfoŋ ja wu lee yeh yi bvuguu yiyu le ki wu yɛ̂ŋ bamii ba to fɛ ŋka le, wu mo wu yɛŋ muh mu le yu wu baaŋ jii gɛ njú yi ŋka wu bvuguu gɛ.
Wu biih wu le lɛ, ‘Nsaa yaŋ, wo jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ wo lee yeh kfunɛ njɛ wo le bɛ njú yi ŋka sɛŋ?’ Muh wɛɛ mɛ jwe wu chile.
Noo, nfoŋ mo wu jɛmɛ banchɛndaa be le lɛ, ‘Bɛŋ kaaŋ chiaaŋ ye mo bikaa, bɛŋ noŋ wu kijibɛ le akfuuŋ, yo bamii lé bo gê bo beede bo ŋgeji bige.’”

content: No Jiso jɛme noo, wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kêe lɛ Nyo le wu tɛɛŋ bamii ba duude, geenɛ wu cha gɛh nyu ba shige.”

content: Bo telɛ Jiso kune ŋwa wu laŋɛ
Bafalashii mo bo ja bo gɛɛŋ bo seesɛ no bo lé bo gê fɛ Jiso loŋsɛ njɛme bo koo wu.

Bo mo bo tuŋ booŋ baboo ba ŋgoo mo ŋgoo yi bamii ba Nfoŋ Hɛlod fɛ Jiso le. Bo gɛɛŋ bo jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, bee kee lɛ wo le muh wù nchiɛɛŋ, wo yɛyi bamii bɛ jɛ yi Nyo a je yì nchiɛɛŋ le. Gɛ wo jode lɛ muh mu le yeye gɛ, nje gɛ wo jiiŋe muh yi fiɛɛ fì wu le fi le gɛ.
Gɛh sɛɛŋ bee wo ŋkwajɛ. Nchi le wu bɛɛŋ lɛ bee lâaŋe ŋwa Kaisa Nfoŋ wu Lum le, noo keefɛ bee lâaŋe gɛ le?”
Jiso kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì bo wɛɛne bɛ fi, wu mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ bamii ba jɛme yeye, bɛŋ gee yeye banɛ, bɛŋ tele mɛ nje la?
Bɛŋ to bɛ bige bì bɛŋ to bɛŋ laaŋe ŋwa yu n'yɛŋ.”

content: Bo to bɛ danale bo nya wu le.
Jiso biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Kikwɛɛ kinɛ kì le yu le ki yɛɛŋ? Jee chinɛ chì le yu le chi yɛɛŋ?”

content: Bo chvuu lɛ, “Le ki Kaisa lɛ, jee le tɛ che.” Wu mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ nyâa Kaisa le fiɛɛ fì le fi Kaisa, bɛŋ nyâa Nyo le fì le fi Nyo.”

content: Bo yu noo, jwe yuŋ lo bo. Bo mo bo chinɛ wu le bo ja bo gɛɛne.
Ba telɛ Jiso kune mbu yi kwe le
Gɛh abvu, Basadushii ja bo to fɛ Jiso le. Basadushii banɛ gɛ̀ bee ŋgoo yi bamii ba gɛ̀ duu lɛ gɛ bamii nyu bo ge bo bu yi kwe le gɛ. No bo to, bo biih wu le lɛ,
“Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, Musɛ gɛ̀ saŋ lɛ, ‘Nɛ muh kwe lo mwa sɛŋ, tu mwa bwee kɛme ki wu gɛ̂ɛ kwɛse wuyu bɛ wu boo booŋ a jee chi ŋkfu mwa bwee le.’
Mɛɛse, booŋ ba muh mu gɛ̀ chee besa bo yanɛ bvusooshwi. Wù ŋgamu gɛ̀ jo kwɛse, wu jiɛnyɛ wu kwe bɛ wu baaŋ kɛme gɛ mwa gɛ, wu chinɛ kwɛse wuyu wù bii wu le.
Fi kooshɛ gɛh noo bɛ wù ka bii wɛɛ le mo wù bii wu wɛɛ le, gɛɛŋ bu fɛ wu bvusooshwi le.
Ajiŋ ayu, kwɛse wɛɛ kwe tɛ.
Noo, mɛɛse no bo bachii bvusooshwi gɛ̀ jo kwɛse wɛɛ, lé gê doo nyume sege bamii bude yi kwe le, kwɛse wɛɛ nyû kwɛ yɛɛŋ?”
Jiso chvuu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ le bɛŋ jiaa, nje gɛ bɛŋ kee fiɛɛ fì ba saŋ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le gɛ. Gɛ bɛŋ kee tɛ bvuŋga bvu Nyo gɛ.

Bɛŋ kêe lɛ lé tô nyume sege bamii bude yi kwe le, gɛ bilɛŋsɛ bɛ bikɛse baaŋ bo ka bo taashi bvuguu gɛ, gɛ bamii baaŋ bo ka bo nyaa booŋ bo taashi bvuguu gɛ. Bo lé bo tô bo nyume wa njɛ banchɛndaa ba Nyo fɛwe
Doo nyume kune mbu wu bamii lé bo gê bo bude yi kwe le, bɛŋ gɛ̀ baaŋ a tɛɛŋ gɛ a Ŋwa wu Nyo le bɛŋ yu fiɛɛ fì wu jɛme bɛŋ le gɛ? Nyo gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,
‘Le mɛ wù Nyo wu Ablaham bɛ Nyo wu Asik mo Nyo wu Yakob.’ Fi le lɛ gɛ Nyo nyume Nyo wu baŋkfu gɛ, le Nyo wu bamii ba baaŋ yu.”

content: Kinchvu ki gɛ̀ lɛme fo yu nchvusɛ wù Jiso chvuse, jwe yuŋ lo bo bɛ n'yɛyɛ we.
Nchi wù fede banchi bachii
Bafalashii gɛ̀ doo bo yu lɛ Jiso le wu baŋɛ lo jwe wu Basadushii, bo mo bo banyɛ ye bo to fɛ wu le.
Muh mu bo le wù gɛ̀ kee banchi ba Nyo chuule wu mo wu telɛ wu bɛ mbilɛ wumu lɛ,
“Muh wù n'yɛyɛ, nchi wù kuge wu fede banchi bachii le wù la?”
Jiso chvuu wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Nchi wù kuge le wù duu lɛ, ‘Wo kôŋe Tada wù Nyo wo bɛ fitele fiuŋ fichii, wo nyâ ye yo wu le yichii, wo gɛ̂ɛ bvufee bwuŋ yi wu le bvuchii.’
Wunɛ le nchi wù fwe wù kuge wù fede banchi bachii.
Wù bii wu le nyume njɛ wunɛ. Fì le lɛ, ‘Wo kôŋe muh wu le mbebe yo le no wo koŋe kikwɛɛ kuŋ.’
Mwɛɛ munchii mù le a Ŋwa wu banchi le, mo mù le a Baŋwa ba bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo le, mu lɛme nyu yi banchi ba bafɛɛ banɛ le.”

content: Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka le mwa yɛɛŋ?
No Bafalashii gɛ̀ taashɛ fo, Jiso mo wu ja wu biih mbilɛ wumu bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ kwaji lɛ la kune Mbvusɛ wù Nyo gɛ̀ ka? Bɛŋ kwaji lɛ le mwa yɛɛŋ?”

content: Bo chvuu wu le lɛ, “Le mwa Nfoŋ Dabi.”
Jiso kaasɛ wu biih bo le lɛ,

content.text: “No le mwa Nfoŋ Dabi, fi jiɛnyi nɛɛ fɛ Kiyo ki Yuude ge Dabi tu wu tɛŋe wu lɛ Tada we? Dabi gɛ̀ jɛmɛ lɛ,
‘Tada Nyo gɛ̀ be wu jɛmɛ Tada waŋ le lɛ,
wu shîi a kibo ke kinchiɛɛŋ le,
gɛ̂ɛŋ bû sege wu lé wu gê wu gîiŋsɛ bamii be ba kimbanɛ,
wu tomɛ bikaa bie yi bo le.’
Nɛ Dabi tɛŋe wu lɛ Tada we, fi ka fi jiɛnyɛ nɛɛ fɛ wu tu wù nyu mwa ye?”

content: No Jiso jɛmɛ nɛ, muh gɛ ka wù nyu yu wu mumwaa wu chvuu fiɛɛ wu le gɛ. Kɛge tɛ abvu, muh gɛ ka wu moŋ lo wu biih fiɛɛ wu le gɛ.
